title: The Azure Court Physician's Treatise
summary: A treatise of the court physicians that gathers every lesser remedy under one measured restoration of the whole soul.

title: The Twin Court Healing Canon
summary: A canon of two cooperating healers who join their force over one patient and reconcile a soul split by grief or blow.

title: The Unending Basin Remedies
summary: Remedies drawn from a basin of soul force that the healer keeps filled and pours out over a patient without running dry.

title: Remedies of the Hawk's Wing
summary: Remedies that lift a fallen soul on broad wings of force and carry it clear of the darkness that holds it.

title: The Gentle River Physician
summary: A physician's book on healing as a river heals its banks slowly and widely and with a force that nothing dams.

title: Wind-Sworn Great Healing
summary: The great healing of the wind-sworn that carries a patient through a storm of harm to a whole soul on the far side.

title: The Oath-Voices' Mending Litany
summary: A litany sung over a patient in which each verse sets one part of the soul back in its place.

title: The Long Bearing Healer's Course
summary: A course for the healer who must keep a true bearing and a steady hand through many patients across many days.

title: The Open Wind Mender School
summary: Remedies that work with the open air around the patient and let the wind carry the hurt away from the soul.

title: The Unbowed Healer's Oath-Book
summary: An oath-book for the healer who will not bow to despair and teaches every mend that serves a patient given up for lost.
